FN-7PSL22V-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 99
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/20/2024
Senate Bill 99 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Department of
Examiners of Public Accounts by a small undetermined amount to conduct an audit of any entity
making a determination about the eligibility of high school athletes to participate in athletic
events.
In addition, this bill would increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount, to reimburse legislative members of the committee established to review
the audits pursuant to the provisions of this bill for expenses incurred for attending a meeting of
the committee.
Page 1

FN-7PSL22V-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 99
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/08/2024
Senate Bill 99 as passed the Senate would increase the administrative obligations of the
Department of Examiners of Public Accounts by a small, undetermined amount to conduct an
audit prior to July 1, 2025 of any entity making a determination about the eligibility of high
school athletes to participate in athletic events.
In addition, this bill would increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount to reimburse legislative members of the committee established to review
the audits pursuant to the provisions of this bill for expenses incurred for attending a meeting of
the committee.
